semanticProjection.amountOrFormula: (100–600 gp per elephant tusk) × 1.5 = 150–900 gp per mammoth tusk (derived)
semanticProjection.conditions: Mammoth tusks are 50% heavier and their value is proportionately higher. Apply the explicit proportional value relation to the Elephant value of 100–600 gp each. The resulting 150–900 gp per mammoth tusk is derived, not a printed range.
notes: The 1.5 factor follows the explicit proportional value relation; physical weight alone is not a monetary amount.
Derived per-tusk valuation only. No pair, herd, market adjustment or tusk-condition price is inferred.
